summary: Six distinct Phoenix retail refinance opportunities qualify out of 20 base records (7 records passed the business rules, but R7849 and R8920 are the same property/loan — BIRCH-REF-71420 — so only one sponsor slot is used). Ranked by confirmed maturity ascending then original principal descending: R8920 Birch Park 1 (2027-01-15, $5,760,000), R2258 Birch Crossing 3 (2027-03-15, $6,624,000), R8680 Birch Square 4 (2027-04-15, $7,056,000), R9318 Birch Crossing 5 (2027-05-15, $7,488,000), R7666 Birch Point 6 (2027-06-15, $7,920,000) and R8605 Birch Crossing 7 (2027-07-15, $8,352,000). All loan amounts are original principal, not outstanding balance; outstanding_balance_usd is unknown (null) for every record in the packet. Exclusions were driven by released loans (R4713), unknown loan status (R2031), inferred or unconfirmed maturities and unresolved extension options (R8827, R7439), an executed amendment pushing maturity out of the window (R2900 → 2028-09-30), maturity already outside the window (R9018), stale owner verification (R6767), manager-only relation (R8055), registered-agent-only contact (R9844), a former employee contact (R8097), out-of-scope asset type (R1912) or market (R4315), and post-cutoff publication (R3130). One material caveat: R2258 carries a recorded release published 2026-09-10 — after the as-of cutoff, so it does not control the as-of-2026-08-31 answer, but it should be re-verified before outreach. Per the direct-API control, no workbook or CSV file was created or delivered; the shortlist facts and citations above are the complete deliverable content that a prospect CSV would contain (columns: record_id, entity_id, owner_entity_id, maturity_date, original_principal_usd, outstanding_balance_usd, contact_name, contact_email, source_ids), with explicit nulls preserved.
limitations: outstanding_balance_usd is null in every base extract; all dollar figures cited are original principal (loan_amount_basis = original_principal) and must not be read as current balances.

R2258 has a recorded release (U-R2258-2) published and effective 2026-09-10, after the 2026-08-31 cutoff. Under the as-of rule it does not control, but the loan is very likely paid off in reality — verify before any outreach.
R8680's shortlisted maturity relies on the base executed note; an unsigned draft (U-R8680-3) proposes 2028-01-01. If that draft is later executed, the record would drop out of the window.
R3130 (Birch Point 18) may well qualify on substance but its only source is published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff, so it could not be evaluated on permitted evidence.

Duplicate handling: R7849 and R8920 describe the same entity and loan; only R8920 is shortlisted. If the two sources actually reflect different collateral, the shortlist would understate opportunities by one.
No outstanding-balance, lender, rate, DSCR, occupancy or valuation data was supplied, so refinance sizing and urgency cannot be assessed.
Contact emails are reported only where email_basis = published_business; R9318's email is explicitly null. No enrichment or inference of contact details was performed.
Owner and contact verification rests on a single verification date (2026-08-10) per record; no independent corroboration of team-page currency was available in the packet.
Artifact generation (XLSX/CSV) is outside this direct-API control; no file was produced, so the deliverable is the JSON content only.
